name: Present
source:
One of three people called "Ghosts", that chase [url=/c13839]Scrooge[/url] and [url=/c13840]Carol[/url] for some reason. 
Present is a mysterious person whose fate is intertwined with Scrooge and Carol. Present's gender is unknown, but it has a beautiful and sleek appearance. Present's abilities include further manipulation of the effects of the Apocalypse Virus. Present is able to also crystallize many people over a certain radius, and can freely manipulate the Apocalypse Crystal Matter. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Guilty_Crown_characters#Guilty_Crown:_Lost_Christmas]Wikipedia[/url].]
